title: Howard Chaykin
description: "My favorite sequence in STAR IVARS is the assault on the Death Star," say Howard Chaykin, "with its references to all those terrific airwar pictures of the late '40s to the mid-50s." Chaykin pioneered the graphic novel form with EMPIRE and THE STARS MY DESTlNATlON, deconstructed a number of mainstream characters in the '80s (most notably THE SHADOW and BLACKHAWK), created AMERICAN FIAGG! and recentlY developed MIDNIGHT Epic.
